# Severity levels

Used by support and incident response. Terms: [terms](terms.md).

## Severity 1
A production outage or data loss affecting all or most users of a customer, with no workaround.

## Severity 2
A major feature is unavailable or badly degraded, but a workaround exists.

## Severity 3
A minor defect, a question or a request.
